note: Career ratings of the 20 drivers (track-viewer/docs/career-mode.md 2.4), invented to fit the lore and the tier bands. Ages come from teams.json. The academy fills seats the market opens (6.8): invented names (academyNames: seeded first and last names and a nation, once the list runs out), rating rolled 70-78, age 19-22 when called up.
traitsNote: A racing style per driver, by code: it rides with the driver to any team. Built-in moves near the player (src/physics/driver.js, tuning.json rivals.track.traits), the same in every race mode; pace, ratings and car levels are untouched.

nitro.label: Nitro-happy
nitro.line: Fires the nitro the moment the tank has a fifth in it, and never lets it sit.

blocker.label: Never yields
blocker.line: With you close behind on a straight, moves onto your line to keep you there. Once a straight, never into a car alongside.

rough.label: Rough
rough.line: Sits right on your bumper and swings out to pass the moment there is room.

calm.label: Ice-cool
calm.line: Pressure barely registers: almost never runs wide or lifts with you behind.

hothead.label: Hothead
hothead.line: Cracks under pressure: more likely to run wide or lift with you right behind.

gentleman.label: Gentleman
gentleman.line: Side by side, leaves you a car's width rather than squeezing. Clean, never soft.

racecraft.label: Racecraft
racecraft.line: Never blocks on a straight: covers the inside into the braking zone instead, once a corner.

showboat.label: Showboat
showboat.line: Swings wide and sweeping through the slow corners when nobody is close, and makes the time back elsewhere.

rain.label: Rain specialist
rain.line: Comes alive on a wet track and gives a little away in the dry.

home.label: Home hero
home.line: At the home race, presses hard and gives nothing away. Elsewhere, races clean.

consistent.label: Metronome
consistent.line: Never makes a mistake, and never sits on your bumper either.
